summary: Podcast_Pack.aep is a 4K/25p overlay kit for the Cloud.ru podcast. It has 19 RENDER comps: a 7-s intro, an outro end card, a disclaimer card, a 2-line subscribe CTA, and 15 overlays of 10 s each (speaker captions, guest bio, 3-line text-on-plashka callouts, content panels, QR blocks). 13 of the overlays sit on one hand-copied «frame» rig. The rig is an inset light-gray border that flies in on Z, plus green CLOUD.RU/ПОДКАСТ corner tags and a frosted-blur margin made by an adjustment layer. Nothing is parametrized: there are 0 expressions and no Essential Graphics, ≥12 plashka widths are hand-tuned with Scale X keys, and clip/wipe masks are hand-drawn (52 animated mask paths). Every variant (left/right/top, 1 or 2 QRs, a different guest) is a separate hand-edited copy, so the 19 deliverables collapse into ~10 parametric templates. 14 overlays also contain a visible 1920×1080 episode reference frame scaled to 4K, and one 9.64-s SFX each. Only 4 comps have Ready renders, 3 of those have silent audio tracks, and the 9:16 intro exists only as a render. The plan is: cleanup (9 orphan duplicates, NFD file names, reference stills, Advanced 3D, 720p×300% scale chains, split-layer hacks), then one POD_Frame rig plus 9 template rigs using sourceRectAtTime auto-size, Side/Layout dropdowns, Media Replacement slots and Responsive Design–Time. Delivery is mogrt + sfx (+ a pr-preset for the blur margin) in Premiere, ae-template/ffx in AE, and prerender for the intro/outro. Full decode (layer switches, parents, track mattes, keyframes with eases, text styles, masks) is in C:\dev\temp\claude\C--Users------Documents-Cloud-ru-Preset-plugin\b48e0614-1141-4125-9b74-d00eb767441b\scratchpad\work\podcast\deep.json. Readable dumps are in r_*.txt in the same folder; the scripts are deep.py, report.py and diffc.py.

templates.build_notes: LIne Comp 1 is one shape layer «LIne»: Rectangle Path 3630×1956, stroke #D3D3D3, width 100→12 over f0→f20 (influence 73.8/48.9). It is used as a 3D layer with an add-mask equal to the frame rect (normalized 0.0273–0.9727 × 0.0472–0.9528), so only the inner half of the stroke shows. It is the PARENT of the tags, Blur and content layers (123 parented layers in the project). Each tag precomp is a full 4K comp with an 840×132 / 855×132 green rect and Bold 190 px text @85 %; a leading space in « ПОДКАСТ» is used as padding. The text rises via Animator 3 «Text Position 3D» y +170→0 (f19→f32, 79.9/81.5) inside an animated clip mask. At the parent level each tag layer has its own 4-key mask wipe. «Blur» is a 3D adjustment solid 3840×2160 with an inverted mask equal to the frame rect and Fast Box Blur radius 15. The whole group was copied by hand into 13 comps and the timings drifted: LIne exit f212–f246, tag exits f190–f205.

templates.parametrization_plan: Rebuild at native scale (120 px @4K). Body as up to 5 point-text lines, each with an auto-width bar from sourceRectAtTime. Heading with an auto-width cube. Add an exit (or protect the end). Checkbox «Transparent intro phase». RDT: protect 0–1.5 s and the last 1.0 s.

Ae: ae-template — reuse the canonical logo-shot from 1_Логошоты
optional Pr: mogrt — hold duration via RDT

templates.build_notes: Two layers of the same precomp: 0–2.88 s live, then 2.88–30 s with a single Time Remap hold key = freeze trick. The precomp's own exit (f83–f124) is never shown. Layers «умное облако 2» / «Cloud.ru 2» are outlined text and their names don't match content. The cube flip runs on 3D layer LOGO 2 (start 0.33 s).
issues: Duplicate of the logo-shot asset
Freeze done with a duplicate layer
Alpha codec used for an opaque clip (wasted size)
templates.parametrization_plan: Reference the canonical logo-shot comp instead of a local copy. Deliver 4K/FHD prerenders plus a still. If a mogrt is wanted: RDT protects 0–3.0 s and the hold stretches.

problems.detail: A 1920×1080 episode reference frame («Still 2025-12-10 132207_1.x.1.png», Scale 200 %, frame of a real speaker) is a normal visible layer: video on, not a guide layer. It is in 14 of the 15 comps that contain it — all 13 frame overlays plus the disclaimer during f0–f24; only the intro has it switched off. Any prerender or mogrt export would bake an opaque episode frame into the overlay, and a mogrt would also package 6.2 MB of personal footage.
problems.fix: Delete it from the template comps, or move it to _REF as Guide Layers in a working copy only; never ship it. Add a pre-export check in the plugin build script: no footage outside allowed slots.

problems.detail: Zero parametrization in all 47 comps: no Essential Graphics (CIFO/CIF2/CIF3 «Untitled», CcCt=0 everywhere), 0 expressions, no expression controls. Plashka widths are hand-keyed Scale X on ≥12 boxes (e.g. Box_2 102 %, Box_3 81 %, handle plashka 97.4 %→336 %). 108 masks are hand-drawn, 52 of them with animated paths, all at fixed widths. Each variant (side, count, guest) is a hand-edited duplicate. Nothing can be filled «by button» as-is.
problems.fix: Rebuild as ~10 rigs on a shared POD_Frame, using sourceRectAtTime auto-size, Dropdown/Checkbox controls, Media Replacement, RDT and EGP. The same EGP drives the mogrt (Pr) and Essential Properties when the comp is dropped as an ae-template (scriptable via the layer's «ADBE Layer Overrides» group).

problems.detail: The «frosted border» is a 3D adjustment layer («Blur», Fast Box Blur r=15, inverted frame mask) parented to LIne Comp 1 in 13 comps. It only blurs footage inside the same AE comp. In a prerender or a Premiere mogrt it has nothing to blur, so the look disappears.
problems.fix: In Pr, ship a pr-preset (adjustment-layer clip: Gaussian/Box Blur + inverted rect mask inset 2.7 %/4.7 % + 23-f fade) that the plugin inserts under the mogrt. In AE keep the real adjustment layer in the ae-template. Ask whether the blur is mandatory.

problems.detail: (Footage)/SFX/Дисклеймер.wav and (Footage)/SFX/Подписывайтесь на канал CLOUD.RU.wav are NFD-named on disk (decomposed «й»), while the project stores NFC paths. On Windows they stay missing even though relative relink fixes the other 22 references. Ready mov/«Подписывайся! Ссылки в описании.mov» and 2 AppleDouble twins are NFD too.
problems.fix: Rename to NFC (python unicodedata.normalize('NFC')) in the working copy before opening in AE 2026, then verify 0 missing footage. Add NFC normalization to the plugin's asset indexer.

problems.detail: The 9:16 intro exists only as Ready mov/Заставка_ПОДКАСТ_CLOUD.RU_9x16.mov (2160×3840, QuickTime Animation ARGB, 361 MB/7 s, a different vertical layout of the pattern). No comp in Podcast_Pack.aep produces it.
problems.fix: Locate the source project, or rebuild POD_Intro_9x16 from the shared precomps using the render as reference. Standardize the codec to ProRes 4444.

problems.detail: 9 orphan ROOT precomps are stale leftovers of a previous episode: [197] QR_1, [220] QR_2 (empty), [234] QR_3, [249] Cloud.ru, [263] LIne Comp 1, [405] Pre-comp 4 «ССЫЛКИ В ОПИСАНИИ», [459] Подкаст, [476] Подпись_QR_1, [490] Подпись_QR_2 «@ULBI_TV». Pattern_1 exists twice and is identical ([304]/[796]). Duplicate footage items: QR_код_3.wav ×2, Still 1.2.1 ×2, Adjustment Layer 1 ×2, Light Gray Solid 4 ×2, Null 1/2/3 ×2.
problems.fix: Delete the orphans (or keep [405] as a tag-text variant if wanted), point the disclaimer at Pattern_1 [304], then Remove Unused Footage / Consolidate.

problems.detail: The frame rig (LIne Comp 1 + Подкаст + Cloud.ru + Blur) is copied by hand into 13 comps, and the copies have drifted: exit starts range f177–f197 and the LIne exit f212–f246. Tag words live in shared precomps, so editing one changes all. Mirrored variants (Текст на плашке_1/2/3, Контент_1/2, Подпись_спикера_1/2, QR_код_1/2/3, Pre-comp 3/4, Булит/Булит_1) differ only in positions, anchors and 5–10 f offsets.
problems.fix: One POD_Frame precomp with Side/Tags controls. One rig per template type with Side/Layout dropdowns.

problems.detail: 3 comps use the Advanced 3D renderer (ADBE Calder): «Подписывайся! Ссылки в описании» [639], Cloud.ru_WhiteColour [4196], Cloud.ru_BlackColour [4217]. All others use Classic 3D (ADBE Escher). Collect Files lists both renderers. Advanced 3D is GPU-dependent, and a Dynamic Link bug with Advanced 3D comps is reported in the Adobe community. MOGRT support could not be confirmed (Adobe help page returned 403) — treat it as a risk. None of these comps needs Advanced 3D: no lights, cameras or models.
problems.fix: Set all three to Classic 3D before building templates or exporting mogrts.

problems.detail: Per-episode personal content sits inside the template comps: host and guest names, titles, a full guest career bio, social handles (@STRDUB, @VLADIMIR_BALUN_PROGRAMMING, @ULBI_TV), personal QR PNGs and episode frames. A previous episode's content lingers in the orphans.
problems.fix: Ship templates with neutral placeholders. Keep episode data in plugin presets (JSON) or user input, never inside the .aep or .mogrt.

problems.detail: Audio is inconsistent. The 16:9 intro, OUTRO and CTA Ready movs carry silent PCM tracks (peak 0.00), while the 9:16 intro has the SFX baked in and hard-cut at 7 s (peak 0.07 in the last 0.5 s). The intro SFX is 25.72 s (sound until 22.3 s) in a 7-s comp; the disclaimer SFX is 30.36 s in a 10-s comp. Each overlay SFX is one 9.64-s file with an in-hit (0.5–0.8 s), mid-hits (1.3 s or 2.0–2.7 s) and an out-hit (8.8–9.5 s), so it desyncs as soon as the graphic is shortened or RDT-stretched (audio does not follow RDT). The CTA and OUTRO have no SFX at all.
problems.fix: Remove audio layers from template comps. Split each SFX into _in/_mid/_out cues as separate sfx items that the plugin places at the clip's in/out. Fade or deliver the full intro/disclaimer stings. Render prerenders video-only, or with audio consistently.

problems.detail: The intro and disclaimer were built in 1280×720 space and up-scaled: 27 intro layers are parented to null «scale» at 300 %; disclaimer text is 40 px ×300 %; LINES/Vert_lines precomps are 1280×720 with collapse on. It renders crisp thanks to continuous rasterization, but EGP font sizes and paddings read ×3 wrong. It also complicates 9:16/FHD variants and auto-size rigs.
problems.fix: Rebuild at native scale (4K or FHD master, see questions) with real font sizes (e.g. 120 px disclaimer, 190 px tags).

problems.detail: Split-layer hacks: in the intro, «ПОДКАСТ»→«ПОДКАСТ 2» and «CLOUD.RU»→«CLOUD.RU 2» switch at 2.04 s to hidden matte copies scaled Y 135 % / 120 %. In the CTA, «ССЫЛКИ В ОПИСАНИИ» is split into two layers at comp 1.84 s with different masks. In О_госте, non-uniform scale compensation (text Y 176.68 % under a panel at Y 56.6 %). In OUTRO, a freeze via a second layer with a Time Remap hold.
problems.fix: Use one text layer per line with one expression-driven clip mask, uniform scales, and keyed or RDT-stretched holds.

problems.detail: Colours versus cloudru-motion-tokens.json: the frame, plates, intro/disclaimer bg and LIne use #D3D3D3 (81 uses; token gray is #F2F2F2); Контент_3 panel #CECECE; logo cube #31D383 (token green #26D07C, used on the plashki); logo white/black #F8F8F8/#2D2D2D (tokens #FFFFFF/#222222); disclaimer text #B3B3B3; arrows #222222 or white (token arrows #8C959E «never green»). Eases are symmetric ~73–95 % influence, while token «enter» is [16,70]. Tracking varies between −10, −22, −24, −28, −33 and −34.
problems.fix: Decide the canonical palette and eases (question). Expose only token colours in the templates.

problems.detail: Fonts are SB Sans Display Bold (40 uses), Semibold (3) and Regular (1), all corporate and not on Adobe Fonts. A mogrt won't auto-install them, and a missing font silently falls back. The brand notes record a PostScript quirk: Semibold is «SBSansDisplay-Semibold».
problems.fix: The plugin checks the installed PostScript names before inserting a template and warns or blocks. Document a font install step; consider bundling only if licensing allows.

problems.detail: Two architecture assumptions in the brief are wrong or unverified. (1) «MOGRT via ExtendScript is impossible» is false. AE has CompItem.exportAsMotionGraphicsTemplate(), motionGraphicsTemplateName, Property.addToMotionGraphicsTemplateAs() (AE 16.1) and AVLayer.addToMotionGraphicsTemplateAs() for Media Replacement (AE 18.0). Premiere ExtendScript has Sequence.importMGT() and TrackItem.getMGTComponent() to set exposed params; UXP parity for mogrt manipulation is unverified. (2) «ExtendScript EOL Sept 2026»: Adobe's Sept-2026 post (blog.developer.adobe.com/en/publish/2026/09/investing-in-the-future-of-creative-cloud-extensibility-uxp-comes-to-our-flagship-applications) says ExtendScripts are not affected. CEP in Pr: new submissions until Dec 2027, disabled by default Dec 2028. AE: UXP public beta Nov 2026, CEP disabled by default Dec 2028.
problems.fix: Plan mogrt export and insertion as scripted steps (AE build script + Pr importMGT/getMGTComponent). Keep a hybrid CEP/UXP path and verify the Pr UXP mogrt API before committing.

problems.detail: All deliverable comps are 3840×2160. AE-authored mogrts are rendered by the embedded AE engine, so 4K mogrts in FHD sequences cost roughly 4× the render. 162 layers have motion blur on and 131 are 3D (Z-fly), which makes Premiere playback heavy.
problems.fix: Pick a mogrt master resolution matching the edit (question). Consider an FHD master for vectors, and keep 4K prerenders only where needed. Allow a «MB off» checkbox.

problems.detail: 102 of 282 layers are unnamed (every precomp/footage layer in the RENDER comps). Misleading names: «ПОДПИСАТЬСЯЁ…» on «ССЫЛКИ В ОПИСАНИИ»/«ПОДПИСЫВАЙСЯ!» text, «умное облако 2» on the slogan outlines, «Технический лидер CLOUd.ru» (casing typo). Typos: «CREEN_CUBE_2», «Tiangle_1», «LIne», «Verts_lines_2». Generic names: «Pre-comp 3/4», «Shape Layer 1-5». Comp names with leading spaces: «  QR_1/2/3».
problems.fix: Adopt CR_POD_<Template>_<Part> naming; scripts and EGP should key on names, not indices.

problems.detail: Подпись_спикера_1 nests the whole Подпись_спикера_2 RENDER comp as a hidden 20 % reference layer. Footage item «Подпись_спикера_2.wav» points to Подпись_спикера_1.wav (no _2 file exists). Text layers end at 10.32 s, past the 10-s comps. 56 layers carry an alpha track-matte mode with no matte layer; this is probably the inert AE 2023+ default, so just verify. 35 layers use AE 2023+ any-layer track mattes, so Premiere ≥ 23 is required (PP 2026 is fine).
problems.fix: Remove the nested reference, rename or replace the SFX item, trim layers, and verify the matte flags in AE.

problems.detail: 21 AppleDouble «._*» files. 7 unreferenced audio files in (Footage)/ root that are not in the .aep or the Collect report: Podcasts_1.wav (2:40, 30.7 MB), _experimental.wav, «02 Simple Whoosh B.wav», «Whoosh 42.mp3», «SoundsCrate-Fighting-Woosh-9.mp3», «soundscrate-air-woosh-2.mp3», «SCIMach_SMorph_Motion Graphics - Micro SFX 04.wav» (96 kHz/24-bit with cover art). Some are third-party stock SFX.
problems.fix: Delete the ._ files. Move the loose audio to _sources or delete it after the user confirms, and check stock-SFX licences before redistributing them in a plugin.

problems.detail: Expression engine is legacy «extendscript». There are 0 expressions, so switching is risk-free, but every new auto-size rig must target the JavaScript engine (faster in Premiere mogrts).
problems.fix: Project Settings → Expressions → JavaScript before rigging.

problems.detail: Ready mov codecs are inconsistent: ProRes 4444 12-bit for 16:9 versus QuickTime Animation 8-bit for 9:16, and an alpha codec for the opaque OUTRO. 7_Пресеты_Media_Encoder holds only H.264 presets (ExporterFileType H264) — none with alpha.
problems.fix: Add ame-presets CR_ProRes4444_Alpha (4K/FHD, video-only) and CR_ProRes422HQ (opaque), and re-render the prerenders consistently.

questions_for_user: Where is the source comp for Ready mov/Заставка_ПОДКАСТ_CLOUD.RU_9x16.mov? It is not in Podcast_Pack.aep. Is a 2160×3840 vertical really needed, or is 1080×1920 enough?
What resolution are podcast edits cut at in Premiere: UHD 3840×2160 25p or FHD 1920×1080 25p? This decides the mogrt master size and which prerender variants to produce.

Which look is canonical for podcasts: the pack's palette and timing (#D3D3D3 frame/plates/bg, logo cube #31D383, dark/white arrows, symmetric ~75–95 % eases), or cloudru-motion-tokens.json (#F2F2F2, #26D07C, arrows #8C959E, enter ease [16,70])?
Is the frosted-blur margin outside the frame required in Premiere? A mogrt cannot blur the edit underneath, so it needs an extra adjustment-layer clip that the plugin would insert.

SFX: keep them as separate in/out cues placed by the plugin, or bake them into prerenders? And can the 7 unreferenced audio files in (Footage)/ (Podcasts_1.wav and the stock whooshes from SoundsCrate/SCIMach) be dropped, or are they licensed sources to keep?
Should the intro's show title be editable for other shows, or stay fixed as «ПОДКАСТ CLOUD.RU» (prerender only)?
Should the plugin store per-episode presets (guest name/title/handles/QR URLs) and generate QR codes from URLs, instead of you replacing PNGs by hand?

animation_patterns.name: plashka-grow-x
animation_patterns.description: Scale X 0→100 % (Y fixed) on a box anchored at its left or right edge; speeds 0, pure influence ease. Callouts: in 23 f (f30→f53), start-key out-influence 73.4 % / land-key in-influence 75 %; hold; exit 18 f (f190→f208) at 76.6 / 80.2 %. CTA: 19 f (76.7/79.9). QR handle: 20 f (75.3/89.6). Intro cubes: 28 f (90.9/94.5). Speaker plate: 20–22 f (82.1/84.1). Stagger 7–10 f per line (CTA: 9 f via layer start).
animation_patterns.candidate_preset: ffx CR_PlashkaGrowX (in + exit keys); pr-preset: Transform effect Scale Width 0→100 % with the same bezier

animation_patterns.name: word-rise-clip
animation_patterns.description: Text animator Position Y +170…+195 px (≈1.9 em on 100-px callout text) with Range Selector Based on Words; Start 0→100 over 20–23 f. Callouts ease 40.8 / 35.5; speaker caption 81.6 / 90.6 (inconsistent between templates). Exit Start 100→0 over 18–20 f (76.6/80.2 or 75.7/90.3). A rectangular mask at the baseline clips the rising words. Text starts ~13 f after its box.
animation_patterns.candidate_preset: ffx CR_WordRiseClip (animator + range keys + expression mask from sourceRectAtTime); mogrt-only in Pr (no per-word animation in Pr)

animation_patterns.name: tag-text-rise
animation_patterns.description: Animator «Text Position 3D» keyed directly y +170→0 over 13 f (f19→f32, 79.9/81.5) while the clip mask on the text layer grows over the last 7 f (f25→f32). Used inside the corner-tag precomps; the outer layer adds a mask wipe.

animation_patterns.name: line-rise-fade
animation_patterns.description: Range Selector Based on Lines with Opacity 0 + Position Y +169 px; Start 0→100 over 9 f (71.9/73.5); exit 100→0 over 8 f (92.5/76.5). Line 2 starts 9 f later.
animation_patterns.candidate_preset: ffx CR_LineRiseFade; pr-preset approximation: Transform Position Y +8 % + Opacity over 9 f

animation_patterns.name: frame-z-fly + stroke-thin
animation_patterns.description: 3D layer Position Z −1290→0 over 23 f (out 79.3 / in 81.7) with all overlay elements parented to it; LIne stroke width 100→12 px over 20 f (73.8/48.9). Exit Z 0→−1266 over 26 f (73.7/87.6). Needs Classic 3D and the default comp camera; motion blur on.

Arrows are alpha-matted by the plate (Cube_1) or the pattern (Background Outlines). In the intro and disclaimer the Fill colour flips white→#222222 at f24→f25.

animation_patterns.description: Range Selector on Words with Opacity 0 + Y +72; Start 0→100 linear over 11 f. No exit of its own; hidden by the panel mask.

animation_patterns.name: freeze-hold
animation_patterns.description: A second copy of the precomp layer with a single Time Remap hold key at 2.88 s runs to 30 s, freezing the last frame of the build.
animation_patterns.candidate_preset: replace with RDT hold (mogrt) or a keyed hold
